fields.label: Initiative owner
fields.help: The person accountable for this initiative: you, or someone you name.

fields.label: Data sensitivity
fields.help: SBU means sensitive but unclassified. FTI means federal tax information.

fields.label: How does the data get into EDP?
Mission value levers
fields.help: Select every IRS outcome this onboarding advances. The EDP business and ROI review scores the request against these levers.

fields.label: Business justification
fields.placeholder: e.g. Enables the Return Preparer Office to score preparer risk weekly instead of quarterly, closing a tax gap segment and retiring three contractor-run extracts.

fields.label: Staff hours saved per year
fields.help: Includes contractor and O&M effort avoided.

fields.label: Datasets
fields.help: Each dataset needs a domain (or Other), a dataset tag and at least one dataset owner. Dataset owners decide who works on the dataset once the initiative is active.

fields.label: Does this work need to be isolated from other tenants?
options: Yes — it must be isolated from other tenants

fields.label: How many people will work on this initiative?
fields.help: Count everyone who will build, test or manage the datasets, not the data consumers who only read them.

engModels.name: We have our own resources
engModels.desc: Our team builds the pipelines and models using EDP patterns, guidelines and reference notebooks. No platform-team engineering capacity needed.

engModels.name: Guided build — light platform help
engModels.desc: Our engineers build, with EDP platform team pairing on pattern review, code review and a design walkthrough.

engModels.name: We need data engineering support
engModels.desc: EDP platform team builds the ingestion and medallion transformations for us. Requires platform engineering capacity in the CCB decision.

ingestPatterns.name: EFTU secure file transfer
ingestPatterns.desc: Scheduled file drops from the source system via EFTU into EDP.

ingestPatterns.name: Informatica ETL
ingestPatterns.desc: Informatica extracts and loads the source into EDP bronze tables.

ingestPatterns.name: EPZ bucket landing zone
ingestPatterns.desc: Source writes objects to the EPZ landing bucket; EDP ingests from there.

ingestPatterns.name: Something else (needs consultation)
ingestPatterns.desc: Direct DB links, APIs, streaming or custom connectors require an EDP architecture consultation.

accessPatterns.name: All within Databricks
accessPatterns.desc: Notebooks, SQL editor and dashboards inside Databricks only.

accessPatterns.name: Tableau
accessPatterns.desc: Tableau connects to Databricks SQL warehouse via Unity Catalog.

accessPatterns.name: Power BI
accessPatterns.desc: Power BI connects to Databricks SQL warehouse via Unity Catalog.

accessPatterns.name: Other tool / data extract (needs consultation)
accessPatterns.desc: Extracts to other platforms or custom apps require an EDP architecture consultation.

source.name: IDRS / Integrated Data Retrieval System
source.desc: Account and case data from the IDRS operational system.

source.name: Other / not listed (needs consultation)
source.desc: A source system not in the approved catalog requires an EDP data architecture consultation.

roiLevers.name: Reduce fraud and improper payments
roiLevers.measure: Estimate refund fraud / improper payments prevented per year.

roiLevers.name: Reduce the tax gap
roiLevers.measure: Estimate additional assessments or collections enabled per year.

roiLevers.name: Better taxpayer services
roiLevers.measure: Estimate value of faster case resolution and fewer taxpayer touches.

roiLevers.name: Reduce cost and contractor support
roiLevers.measure: Estimate contractor hours and O&M dollars avoided per year.

roiLevers.name: Reduce IT spend / retire duplicate systems
roiLevers.measure: Estimate license, hosting and duplicate-system costs retired per year.

roiLevers.name: Improve data quality, security and compliance posture
roiLevers.measure: Estimate rework, audit findings and manual controls avoided per year.

computePolicy.title: Standard compute policy
computePolicy.summary: Every initiative starts on EDP's standard compute policy. This is an overview only — there is nothing to choose here.

items.label: All-purpose compute
items.value: Standard access mode (user isolation) under the all-purpose cluster policy

items.label: Job compute
items.value: Job clusters under the job cluster policy, ending when each run finishes

items.label: SQL warehouse
items.value: A SQL warehouse in every environment, created at standup

items.label: Other limits
items.value: Runtime, autoscaling and cost ceilings aren't set by the policy yet

computePolicy.changeNote: Need something different? You can ask EDP to change your compute policy after your initiative is active.
